title: r3 re-bless scope lists the qos log, but 121d8a0 leaves it byte-identical (the false-scope class the commit itself just corrected)
evidence: change-log _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md:175: "  no intent gaps, no bad specs. Re-bless scope this round: qos T1/log/PNGs, warn 65s PNG, surge PNGs +"; commit message: "Re-bless scope (all cause-documented): qos T1/log/PNGs (the churn fix + the mojibake), warn 65s PNG + surge PNGs + one new capture (mojibake + the T2 bracket); everything else byte-identical."; same message: "SCOPE CORRECTION: the r1-fix round claimed qos T1/log/T2 re-blessed — false (the log + PNGs were byte-identical; only qos.t1 moved)."; git show 121d8a0 --stat lists only " goldens/qos.t1 | 600 ++++++++++-----------" and " goldens/qos/65000ms.png | Bin 44696 -> 44593 bytes" — no qos.log.bin; git diff f906725 121d8a0 --stat -- goldens/qos.log.bin is empty (the log moved only in b94d54f, via the catalog_hash header fold).
detail: The scope line names the log as re-blessed this round, but the r3 commit does not touch goldens/qos.log.bin. The commit's own SCOPE CORRECTION defines byte-identical as not-re-blessed, so the disclosure repeats the inaccuracy it corrected.
recommended_fix: Strike "log" from the r3 scope line or mark it "regenerated byte-identical (action log — the catalog_hash fold was the 4.2 commit's change)". Align the commit message the same way.
